name: token-efficient-agent
description: Vendor-neutral token efficiency plugin for compact replies, compact tool use, and compressed agent context.

interface.shortDescription: Compact agent work with exact technical detail.
interface.longDescription: A vendor-neutral plugin scaffold that teaches agents to reduce input and output tokens by using compact replies, narrow retrieval, log and diff summarization, memory compression, and raw-detail fallback when exact text matters.
defaultPrompt: Compress logs and keep only decisive errors.
Keep replies compact but technically exact.
